title: verifier
description: One verifier run on a task's head: a verdict. Set verdict and notes, then only the fields that go with the verdict.

verdict.description: pass: nothing meets the blocking bar. request_changes: something does; set findings. question: a criterion is ambiguous; set questions. Set no other verdict's fields.

notes.description: A few lines of Markdown, without headings: what you judged and what you found, whatever the verdict.

findings.description: With verdict request_changes: each defect that meets the blocking bar.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion the finding is tied to, quoted from the task, in one line.

class.description: The line of the blocking bar the finding falls under.

detail.description: A few lines of Markdown, without headings: what's wrong, and where.

follow_ups.description: With any verdict: each defect rarer than the blocking bar, and none that followups.md lists. Only a pass files them.

title.description: The candidate's title, in one line.

scope.description: One scope from the preamble's list, without the scope: prefix.

scenario.description: What has to happen for the defect to show, in one line.

likelihood.description: How likely that is, in one line.

impact.description: What goes wrong when it happens, in one line.

questions.description: With verdict question: this round's questions, most blocking first.

text.description: The question, in one line that stands alone.

blocks.description: The issue numbers the question blocks.

recommended.description: The option you recommend, listed first.

why.description: Why you recommend it, in one line.

others.description: The other options, one line each.
